title: India’s Pocket FM doubles revenue run rate to $500M as AI powers 93% of audio content
slides: Can Pocket FM's $500M run rate survive AI?
Revenue doubled, but 93% of content is now AI-made
Listeners can't tell the difference — or can they?
Audio creators must now compete with machines
Test one AI-narrated story against a human one
thread_text:
1. The 93% problem

Pocket FM hit a $500M run rate. But 93% of its content is now AI-made. Listeners are still tuning in.

2. Can you tell?

Blind tests are mixed. Most people can't pick the AI voice from the human one. That's the unsettling part.

3. Creators vs. machines

Voice actors now bid against models that never sleep and cost pennies. The economics flipped overnight.

4. No slowdown yet

Revenue doubled while human roles shrank. The growth didn't come from better stories — it came from cheaper ones.

5. Test it yourself

Pick an AI-narrated story and a human one. Listen blind. If you can't tell, ask what you're really paying for.
